'''Master Herod''' is the Innkeeper of [[Harilin's Leap]] in [[Jarra]] in Ghealdan.

== Activities ==
[[Rand]] stayed there when he was on the way to [[Tear]]. [[Perrin]], [[Loial]], [[Moiraine]] and [[Lan]] stayed there when they were chasing Rand.{{ref/book|3|8}}
